Title: Concurrent reserve() oversells stock
Severity: high
Location: src/inventory.ts:54-76

reserve() reads stock, awaits, then writes an absolute value without the SKU lock that restock/release take, so concurrent reservations oversell the last units (lost update).

Severity: critical

Severity: high
Location: src/job-queue.ts:88-104
